attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 13
attributes.name: Vision
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to examine any location deck. After you finish examining, if the location deck contains a villain, it escapes as if undefeated.

After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 15 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
